notes.title: [Version update] Optimize the loading speed of model and dance list UI
notes.content:
When there are too many models or dances in the Installed list, in the previous version, the speed of switching models or dancing UI was too slow or even stuck for about a second. 
After the deep optimization of this version, no matter how many models dance in the Installed list, it can be very smooth and instantly open in seconds. No more stuttering issues.

notes.title: [FREE UPDATE] DesktopMMD4 Released! It's time for dance again now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35146874/6186abe9122310750ae3d5607bc3bd27f408fac8.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968650/

If you have purchased DesktopMagicEngine or DesktopMMD3 then it will be given to your library for free.


IT'S TIME FOR DANCE AGAIN NOW!
DesktopMMD4 is mainly born to solve the clip through problem of the previous version of the model and the inability to directly import VMD dance files. After more than a year of exploration, I finally found a new way and fully switched to the original MMD technology framework, which not only realized the ability to directly support the import MMD's VMD dance action files, and directly use the original MMD physics engine to dance without the problem of clip through the model, and even directly support the lip-sync and facial with the VMD dance, making it easier for the model to dance on the desktop with richer details.



WHAT'S NEW
(1) Support Directly import the VMD dance motion files of MMD without conversion, and supports the lip-sync and facial expressions .
(2) Support directly import the PMX/PMD model file of MMD without conversion and better compatibility .
(3) Support the physical effects of MMD, and no longer clip through model when dancing.
(4) Support switch two rendering styles of model with one click: 2D Anime rendering style and 3D realistic rendering style.
(5) Support directly import the VPD action file of MMD without conversion.
(6) Support multiplayer motions in a dance, allowing multiple models to load different VMDs to dance different motions.
(7) Brand-New lightweight rendering engine, which uses less system resources and reduces the GPU usage by as much as 60% compared with the previous generation.


MORE VIDEO PREVIEW
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1968650/videos/?p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent

notes.title: Add NEW Action Module, Support Custom Motion, Voice and Emotion, Support LipSync
notes.content:
Add NEW Interactive Action Module, Support Custom Motion, Voice and Emotion, Support LipSync,Support STEAM Workshop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173292/39b161f81f7ed0f0a2726a6c25495993f643f884.jpg

Where is the Action Module?
Click the DMMD3 tray icon (next to the WIFI icon in the lower right corner of the screen) to open the management UI , click the third button on the left side to open the action management UI .You can uncheck the actions you don't like.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173292/60e100bf7a79f2c9187c48c1005f538672ee78bf.jpg

How to uses the Action?
You can click the character model with the left mouse button on the desktop, the model will be randomly selected from the checked actions to play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173292/c7686945ec8677329530f8c106bb10372cc7b1ac.jpg


How to edit or create your own custom actions?
Click the + button in the lower left corner of action manage UI to create a new action.
Right-click in the action list to edit existing actions.

In the action edit UI, you can select or import motion files (Built-in 75 female motions and 68 male motions), select or import wav voice files (Built-in 126 female voice and 126 male voice), select  emotions, and set delay or duration, all of which can be previewed in real time.
You can also click the preview test button in the lower left corner of the window to preview it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39173292/dbfaed46140b11c2e40afe3f3e0e3cdda0cb447f.jpg
